nodes.description: Apply properties of operations as strategies to multiply and divide.* Examples: If 6 × 4 = 24 is known, then 4 × 6 = 24 is also known. (Commutative property of multiplication.) 3 × 5 × 2 can be found by 3 × 5 = 15, then 15 × 2 = 30, or by 5 × 2 = 10, then 3 × 10 = 30. (Associative property of multiplication.) Measure or interpret tiled regions using square centimeters, square meters, square inches, square feet and improvised square units.
Reject a square count as an area measurement when square sizes are mixed or the covering has gaps or overlaps.
set.description: Measure a plane region by covering it with equal unit squares without gaps or overlaps. Interpret the count as area in square units, using standard or chosen square units.
set.name: Measuring area with unit squares
